_comment: Per-set × per-case budgets over pano_metrics.py outputs (test_pano_pipeline.sh). One-way ratchet: ceilings only go DOWN; the coverage FLOOR only goes UP (it gates BELOW-budget — more coverage is better). UNLIKE the color harness's observed+10% seeding, the entries below are the spec/product TARGETS (stitching spec §5.3/§7; product P0-2/P0-3: zero dropped frames on well-shot sets, mean ≤ 1.5 px, max ≤ 6 px, horizon ≤ 0.3°) — committed RED by design: frames the rotation model cannot yet hold (parallax floor, see #1212 and the local-alignment work) are still dropped, which empties canvas sectors. The render-completeness keys (coverage/rmse/seam_energy, added 2026-06-12) encode the demonstrated all-21 render of pano_01 (#1213 geometry, gate-relaxed operator run: coverage 0.929, rmse 0.2027, seam 8.86e-4) so a half-empty canvas can never again score as 'green except a frame count'. The gates stay red until the pipeline earns them; do not relax them to pass.
